salt.title: Salt DS

iconSets.mechanism: SemanticIconProvider — 33 semantic slots (CloseIcon, ChevronDownIcon, CalendarIcon, …), each accepts any React icon component; components resolve icons by ROLE, not by import

constraints: Radius is NOT a knob — Salt is sharp (0) everywhere except pills (999px).
Density rescales control heights, spacing, text, type roles and icon size together — there is no per-instance size prop.
Actions are uppercase 600 with 0.6px tracking — not configurable.
Salt ships ONE icon size per density (size-icon) with an integer multiplier; inline and control icons are therefore the same size, emphasis = multiplier 2.
Salt has no separate caption ramp — caption resolves to the label ramp at regular weight.
Default icon set is Salt's own 12px first-party set (~548 icons; 62 SVGs mirrored in themes/salt/assets). Swapping is per semantic role via SemanticIconProvider, not per-import like shadcn's migrate.

shadcn.title: shadcn neutral
constraints: No density switching — the scale is fixed to the 4px grid.
Radius is a free knob (--radius); all derived radii follow.
No dedicated inverse surface — inverse-* is the opposite mode's surface pair.
Fields are transparent-filled: field-surface tracks surface and does not change on hover.
